mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT book_id FROM vocabulary_book_word WHERE content_id=#{content}

SELECT ki.source_content_id FROM review_schedule rs JOIN knowledge_item ki ON ki.id=rs.knowledge_id AND ki.owner_id=rs.owner_id WHERE rs.id=#{schedule} AND rs.owner_id=#{owner} AND ki.source_content_id IS NOT NULL
SELECT learning_status FROM learning_record WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND content_id=#{content} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE vocabulary_book_study_record r SET r.ended_at=#{at},r.final_learned_count=(SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT lr.content_id) FROM learning_record lr JOIN vocabulary_book_word w ON w.content_id=lr.content_id WHERE lr.owner_id=r.owner_id AND w.book_id=r.book_id AND lr.learning_status IN ('understood','mastered')),r.updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE r.owner_id=#{owner} AND r.book_id<>#{book} AND r.ended_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO vocabulary_book_study_record(id,owner_id,book_id,round_no,selected_at,carried_learned_count) SELECT #{id},#{owner},#{book},COALESCE(MAX(round_no),0)+1,#{at}, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT lr.content_id) FROM learning_record lr JOIN vocabulary_book_word w ON w.content_id=lr.content_id WHERE lr.owner_id=#{learnedOwner} AND w.book_id=#{learnedBook} AND lr.learning_status IN ('understood','mastered')) FROM vocabulary_book_study_record WHERE owner_id=#{roundOwner} AND book_id=#{roundBook}
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM vocabulary_book_study_record WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND book_id=#{book} AND selected_at>=#{dayStart} ORDER BY round_no DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT book_id FROM user_vocabulary_book WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND state='active' ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE vocabulary_book_study_record r SET r.ended_at=GREATEST(COALESCE((SELECT uvb.paused_at FROM user_vocabulary_book uvb WHERE uvb.owner_id=r.owner_id AND uvb.book_id=r.book_id LIMIT 1),#{at}),COALESCE(r.selected_at,#{selectedAt})),r.final_learned_count=(SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT lr.content_id) FROM learning_record lr JOIN vocabulary_book_word w ON w.content_id=lr.content_id WHERE lr.owner_id=r.owner_id AND w.book_id=r.book_id AND lr.learning_status IN ('understood','mastered')),r.updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE r.id=#{round} AND r.ended_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM vocabulary_book_study_record WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND book_id=#{book} AND ended_at IS NULL ORDER BY round_no DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO vocabulary_book_study_daily(id,round_id,owner_id,book_id,business_date,study_count,reviewed_count) SELECT #{id},#{round},owner_id,book_id,#{date},#{study},#{reviewed} FROM vocabulary_book_study_record WHERE id=#{sourceRound}
